primary_input: Exact frozen R14 before patient-relative standardization; indices0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,10,11,12,13; not E14, not Raw96D, not PR features.
label_convention: Archived y=1 NEZ,y=0 EZ; analysis ez=(y==0).
statistical_unit: one patient effect for each of12 coordinates; seizures already aggregated, not independent patients
effect: D=(2U-nEZ*nNEZ)/(nEZ*nNEZ), average ranks with pairwise ties0.5, retain signed direction
missing: Use finite channels per coordinate; require both finite EZ/NEZ classes. No new imputation. Constant coordinate yields0. All-zero patient effect vector p1. Historical safe-float and B0 nan_to_num conventions already part of frozen data and not undone.

bootstrap.interval: unadjusted two-sided percentile95% for mean effect

wilcoxon.interpretation: signed-location test under symmetry assumptions, not the same estimand as a mean bootstrap

multiplicity.source_tests: descriptive only, no source significance flags

permutation.interpretation: pipeline negative-control null means and95% reference intervals; empirical p-values supplementary, never substitute primary Wilcoxon/BH

privacy: Individual patient effects and labels remain server-only; public patient_effect_summary.csv is coordinate-level distribution summary, not960 patient rows; fixed-bin histograms export no stable patient identifier or exact individual effects.
reproducibility: Source SHA and input SHA fixed before analysis. Independent pairwise/ROC effects, tie-corrected Wilcoxon variance, BH and count-matrix bootstrap verification required.
